web.description:
# Tell your employer about your study or training loan
## Why it's important
In the same way your employer withholds tax throughout the year to cover your end of year tax liability, they can also withhold extra amounts to cover your study or training support loan [compulsory repayment](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/study-and-training-support-loans/compulsory-repayments).

Your employer will determine how much extra to withhold based on the income you earn with them.

## Understanding compulsory repayments
### Withholding amounts for your compulsory repayment
When you tell your employer you have a study or training support loan, they will start withholding extra amounts from your income if your annual income is expected to be over the minimum repayment income.

# Compulsory repayments
## Advising your employer
Under the pay as you go (PAYG) withholding system, your employer will withhold an additional amount from your salary and wage income to cover your compulsory repayment.
